LCOM-GEN.description: Load Combination for General analysis results (LCOM-GEN). One combination per key; NAME and the vCOMB list of (analysis type, load case, factor) triples drive the definition, and iTYPE selects how the listed cases are summed.

NO.description: Read-only combination number assigned by the program. Ignored on write (populated only on GET).

NAME.description: Combination name. Must be unique when adding a new combination.

ACTIVE.description: Active state of the combination, e.g. "ACTIVE" or "INACTIVE".

bES.description: Elastic-stage flag (E, Concrete design only). Applied by the handler only for the CONCRETE load-combination type; ignored for LCOM-GEN.

bCB.description: Read-only min/max/CB result-type flag computed by the program (General: false, Min/Max/All: true). Ignored on write.

iTYPE.description: Summation method for the listed cases. 0: Add, 1: Envelope, 2: ABS, 3: SRSS.

iSERV_TYPE.description: EC serviceability type code. Internal/reserved; not currently applied by the handler.

nLCOMTYPE.description: EC load-combination type code. Internal/reserved; not currently applied by the handler.

nSEISTYPE.description: EC seismic type code. Internal/reserved; not currently applied by the handler.

vCOMB.description: List of component cases making up the combination. Each entry is an (analysis type, load case name, factor) triple.

ANAL.description: Analysis type of the referenced load case (case-insensitive). ST: Static, RS: Response Spectrum, TH: Time History, MV: Moving, SM: Settlement, ENVL: Envelope, CB: General Combination, CBS/CBC/CBF/CBR/CBA/CBSC/CBCF/CBSM/CBLN: design combinations, PO: Pushover, CS: Construction Stage, ES: Elastic-stage, GI: Geometric-stiffness Initial, CN: Nonlinear, NRS/NES: nonlinear response/elastic-stage.

LCNAME.description: Name of the referenced load case. Must exist for the given ANAL type.

FACTOR.description: Scale factor applied to the referenced load case.
